<thought>The most intense peak is at m/z 141.115 which in positive‑mode ESI is typically the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of about 140.108 Da. A plausible formula that matches this mass is C₈H₁₂O₂ (exact mass 140.0837 Da), which is within typical experimental tolerance.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H12O2</final_answer>
